spreads.headline:
A new standard of
*contemporary* living
spreads.body:
Positioned within Ghana's Eastern Corridor, Eden Ridge introduces a bold new expression of modern residential living — designed for a new generation of homeowners and investors who demand more.

Every residence is globally inspired yet deeply rooted in the spirit of modern Ghanaian living. Architecture that doesn't just house a life — it elevates it.
spreads.pull_quote: Where you live is an extension of who you are.
spreads.caption: Ground Floor — Living Area

spreads.headline: Contemporary *precision*
spreads.body: Clean horizontal lines, expansive glazing, private balconies, and cobblestone forecourts — Eden Ridge makes a statement before you even step inside.

vision.band_body: Eden Ridge is envisioned as more than a collection of residences. It is a thoughtfully planned contemporary community designed around privacy, architecture, wellness, and everyday convenience — establishing a new standard for residential living within Ghana's emerging luxury market.

why.headline: Considered from every angle

process.headline: Payment structure
process.lede: Flexible payment options are available to accommodate homebuyers and investors. Contact us to discuss your individual requirements and preferred structure.

stages.title: Reservation
stages.body: Refundable reservation deposit to secure your preferred unit and confirm your position within the development.

stages.title: Contract
stages.body: Payable upon signing the sale and purchase agreement. Formalises ownership rights and construction commitment.

stages.title: Construction
stages.body: Staged instalments aligned with verified construction milestones throughout the build period.

stages.title: Completion
stages.body: Final balance payable upon completion and handover. Keys released upon full clearance of outstanding amounts.

items.question: What type of home does Eden Ridge offer?
items.answer: Eden Ridge is a collection of contemporary four-bedroom residences, each with private en-suite bathrooms, a walk-in wardrobe, and a private terrace off the master suite, arranged within a gated community in Community 25, Tema.

items.question: Where exactly is Eden Ridge located?
items.answer: The development sits in Community 25, Tema, within Ghana's Eastern Corridor — roughly 50 miles from Accra's CBD and around 60 minutes from Kotoka International Airport, minutes from the Eastern Corridor Highway.

items.question: What is the payment structure?
items.answer: Payment is staged across four points: a refundable $5,000 reservation deposit, 30% on contract signing, 30% through verified construction milestones, and the final 40% on completion and handover. Terms are subject to change — contact us for current details.

items.question: What amenities are included in the community?
items.answer: Confirmed community amenities include a resort-style swimming pool, outdoor lounge areas, a fitness centre, secure gated access, a private clubhouse, children's recreation space, landscaped gardens, and shared utility infrastructure such as backup power and fibre internet readiness.

items.question: Is Eden Ridge suitable for diaspora or overseas investors?
items.answer: Yes. The sales team welcomes enquiries from homebuyers, investors, and diaspora buyers globally, and can walk you through flexible payment options remotely.

items.question: How can I see the residence before construction is complete?
items.answer: A curated video walkthrough of the full residence — living, dining, kitchen, bathroom, and beyond — is available on request. Contact our team to arrange a private viewing or receive the video tour.
